templates.storyLength: {label}: {length} (whole story; this scene is only one part of it)
templates.descriptiveScene: No characters take part in this scene: write it as pure description and narration. Nobody speaks or acts, and no character's thoughts are shown.
templates.otherCastHeading: Other Characters in the Story (not in this scene — you may refer to them, but they must not appear, speak or act):
templates.customDirectivesHeading: Custom Directives (these take precedence over every other instruction, including length):
templates.continuity:
What just happened (end of the previous scene) — do not repeat or restate it; continue from here:
{summary}
templates.reviseInstruction: Please revise and output the improved scene prose incorporating these instructions.
templates.writeInstruction: Please write the narrative prose for this scene beat only. Do not recap or restate earlier scenes.
templates.directivesReminder: Follow the Custom Directives above exactly, including any length limit.
templates.nextScene: Next scene (lead toward it, but do not write it): {title} — {summary}
templates.sceneShape: Shape the scene: open in motion, inside the point-of-view character's goal; escalate the conflict; land the turn; end on a hook that leads into what comes next. Do not end on a summary or a reflection that restates the scene.
templates.outputProse: Output format: put the prose inside <prose> and </prose>, and write nothing outside the tags.
templates.outputProseRecap: Output format: put the prose inside <prose> and </prose>. After </prose>, add <recap>one sentence: what happened in this scene and what changed</recap>. Write nothing else outside these tags.
templates.outputProseContinue: Output format: your answer already starts inside <prose>. Continue the prose, close it with </prose>, and write nothing after it.
templates.outputProseContinueRecap: Output format: your answer already starts inside <prose>. Continue the prose and close it with </prose>. After </prose>, add <recap>one sentence: what happened in this whole scene and what changed</recap>. Write nothing else after it.
templates.continuePrefilled: Your previous answer was cut off before </prose>. It is repeated at the start of your answer: continue it from exactly where it stops, without repeating any of it.
templates.repeatedAnswer: Your previous answer only repeated the text so far. Do not copy any of it: write new prose for this segment that continues from where that text ends.
templates.refineLengthRetry: Your previous rewrite has {words} words, but this request asks for about {target} words. Rewrite the scene again at about {target} words (between {min} and {max}).
templates.inventedNamesRetry: Do not bring in characters the story does not have. These names are not in the story: {names}. Write the prose again using only the characters named above.
